name: EPMC_get_text_mined_annotations
description: Get all unique text-mined annotations from a biomedical article via Europe PMC. Returns the complete deduplicated gene/protein, disease, chemical, organism, GO, and EFO entity sets with mention counts; annotation_counts reports each full group size. Example: PMC5500808 returns more than 70 unique gene/protein entities without silent capping.

pmid.description: PubMed ID (e.g., '33332779'). Either pmid or pmcid is required.

pmcid.description: PubMed Central ID (e.g., 'PMC7781101'). Alternative to pmid.

annotation_type.description: Filter by annotation type. Options: 'Gene_Proteins', 'Diseases', 'Chemicals', 'Organisms', 'Gene_Ontology', 'EFO'. Leave empty for all types.

annotations.description: Deduplicated entities keyed by annotation type; a bare array when annotation_type narrowed the request.

text.description: The mined text as it appears in the article

tag_name.description: Name of the first grounded concept; see tags for all of them

uri.description: URI of the first grounded concept

tags.description: Every grounded concept for this text. A relationship annotation carries both ends, e.g. the gene and the disease of a Gene Disease Relationship.

tag_count.description: How many grounded concepts this text was mapped to

count.description: Number of mentions of this text in the article

sections.description: Article sections the mentions appear in (Title, Abstract, Methods, Results, Discussion, Article)

providers.description: Text-mining providers that produced the mentions, e.g. Europe PMC, Open Targets Platform

sub_types.description: Annotation subType values, where upstream sends one

mentions.description: Up to 5 occurrences, each with the sentence around it, its section and its provider

mentions_truncated.description: True when the entity has more mentions than mentions carries

annotation_counts.description: Number of distinct entities per annotation type

article_source.description: Which Europe PMC source the article came from (MED, PMC, PPR)

ext_id.description: The article id in that source

full_text_ids.description: PMC ids whose full text was mined; empty when only the abstract was

total_annotations.description: Annotations upstream returned before deduplication by mined text

sections.description: Every article section an annotation came from
